title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
summary: Compute the value of an arithmetic expression written in postfix order, where each operator follows its two operands.
hints: An operator always applies to the two most recent values that haven't been used yet. Which structure hands you the most recent values?
Push numbers onto a stack. On an operator, pop twice: the first pop is the right operand, the second is the left one. Push the result back.
Order matters for - and /. Division must truncate toward zero: use Math.trunc(a / b), not Math.floor, which rounds negative results down.

complexity.time: O(n): one pass over the tokens
complexity.space: O(n): the stack of pending operands
